changes: Repository hygiene now supports canonical content-equivalence cleanup for non-main branches with no open PR.
Ancestry cleanup remains the first deletion path.
Non-ancestor branches are deleted only when every branch-specific final file state is byte-identical to canonical main.
Removed paths qualify only when they are also absent from main.
Open PR heads, renames/unsupported statuses, oversized or unavailable deltas, and any divergent content are preserved.
The hygiene summary distinguishes ancestry deletion, content-equivalence deletion, and preserved branches.
